verdict.rationale: The evidence shows workflow choices (Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, Freeform) that set how many review points a task gets. That is an adjacent planning and review control, not documented tiered autonomy or permission levels governing which actions an agent may take without manual confirmation. Community comments discuss approvals generally but do not document such a capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can set tiered autonomy levels controlling what an agent can do without manual confirmation
